input.business_intent: Which product category generates the highest total sales revenue in each store region?

args.sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT column_name FROM (SELECT unnest(columns(*)) as column_name FROM regional_product_category_sales LIMIT 1)

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_rows,
    COUNT("pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as store_count,
    COUNT("pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as product_count,
    COUNT("pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id") as sales_count
FROM regional_product_category_sales

SELECT 
    "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as store_id,
    "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as product_id,
    "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" as sales_id,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM regional_product_category_sales
WHERE "pk_stores 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
   OR "pk_products 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
   OR "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
LIMIT 20

SELECT *
FROM regional_product_category_sales
WHERE "pk_sales_data 1 4_bronze_silver_id" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT _source_file
FROM regional_product_category_sales
ORDER BY _source_file

WITH sales_with_details AS (
    SELECT 
        s.region,
        s.store_name,
        sd.category,
        sd.total_amount
    FROM read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\sales_data 1 4.csv') sd
    INNER JOIN read_csv_auto('C:\Users\amarkkumar\Downloads\Amar_usecase\amar_case\data\landing\stores 1 4.csv') s
        ON sd.store_id = s.store_id
),
category_region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category,
        SUM(total_amount) as total_revenue,
        COUNT(*) as transaction_count
    FROM sales_with_details
    GROUP BY region, category
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        category,
        total_revenue,
        transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) as revenue_rank
    FROM category_region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    category,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    transaction_count,
    revenue_rank,
    CASE WHEN revenue_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Category' ELSE 'Other' END as category_status
FROM ranked_categories
ORDER BY region, revenue_rank
